Find local optima of a landscape

Source: R/landscape.R
find_peaks.Rd

In two dimensions, evaluates the landscape on a regular grid and returns cells that are at least as high as all eight neighbours, dropping the grid border (as in the original analysis scripts). In other dimensions, runs `optim()` from random starts and merges nearby solutions.

Usage

find_peaks(
  landscape,
  lower = 0,
  upper = 15,
  res = 500,
  dim = attr(landscape, "n_dim"),
  n_starts = 200,
  merge = 3
)

Arguments

landscape

A landscape function.

lower, upper

Bounds of the search region (scalar or per dimension).

res

Grid resolution per dimension (2D).

dim

Number of dimensions (taken from the landscape if possible).

n_starts

Number of random starts (other dimensions).

merge

In 2D, maxima closer than this many grid cells are merged, keeping the highest (flat tops otherwise give duplicate peaks). 0 keeps all, as in the original scripts.

Value

Data frame with peak coordinates and `fitness`.
